# Task Breakdown: Todo In-Memory Python Console Application

**Feature**: Todo In-Memory Python Console Application
**Branch**: `1-todo-app-spec`
**Generated**: 2025-12-30
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/1-todo-app-spec/spec.md`

**Note**: This document is generated by the `/sp.tasks` command. See `.specify/templates/commands/tasks.md` for the execution workflow.

## Implementation Strategy

This implementation will follow an MVP-first approach, delivering core functionality incrementally. The strategy is:

1. **MVP Scope**: User Story 1 (Add Todo Item) with basic CLI interface
2. **Incremental Delivery**: Each user story builds on the previous one
3. **Parallel Opportunities**: Domain models and utility functions can be developed in parallel
4. **Independent Testing**: Each user story is independently testable

## Dependencies

User stories follow priority order with dependencies:
- US2 (View Todos) can be implemented independently after foundational setup
- US3 (Mark Complete) depends on US1 (Add Todo) and US2 (View Todo)
- US4 (Update Todo) depends on US1 (Add Todo) and US2 (View Todo)
- US5 (Delete Todo) depends on US1 (Add Todo) and US2 (View Todo)

## Parallel Execution Examples

- Domain models can be created in parallel with service layer implementation
- CLI command handlers can be developed in parallel after the core service is established
- Unit tests can be written in parallel with implementation
